audit_selection.scope: candidate document audit membership; node/token/channel audit positions still require frozen design

streaming_contract.model_weights: load once per bounded job; same immutable quantized objects for both arms
streaming_contract.order: complete one current/reference document pair before releasing its tensors
streaming_contract.statistics: local tensors and continuous hidden outputs remain separate; document-cluster quantiles

streaming_contract.sampling_units: documents are operational source clusters; tokens/tensors/scalars are coverage only
streaming_contract.long_sequences: more than128 positions unsupported by this production path; no extrapolated long-context result

historical_exposure: inherits frozen input limitation; text/URL clusters do not certify semantic independence or all-history holdout
